# SIGMA Blog

> > Official blog featuring professional photographers and cinematographers sharing their creative work with SIGMA lenses, cameras, and cine equipment across photography and filmmaking disciplines.

The SIGMA Blog showcases real-world applications of SIGMA's Art, Contemporary, and Sports lenses, plus Cine lenses and the fp camera system. Content includes lens reviews, filmmaker interviews, and photography tutorials across genres from landscape to documentary filmmaking, with emphasis on L-Mount and mirrorless systems.

## Key Topics

- SIGMA lenses
- L-Mount system
- SIGMA Cine lenses
- SIGMA fp camera
- Art lens series
- Contemporary lens series
- I series compact primes
- 24-70mm F2.8 DG DN II
- 16-28mm F2.8 DG DN
- 70-200mm F2.8 DG DN OS Sports
- Mirrorless photography
- Documentary filmmaking
- Travel photography
- Landscape photography
- Street photography

- [First Look: SIGMA 70-200mm F2.8 DG DN OS Sports Lens for L-Mount](https://blog.sigmaphoto.com/2023/first-look-sigma-70-200mm-f2-8-dg-dn-os-sports-lens-for-l-mount): Jared Polin reviews Sigma 70-200mm F2.8 DG DN OS Sports for L-Mount
- [A Small But Mighty Lens for Landscapes and Travel: Sigma 16-28mm F2.8 DG DN Contemporary](https://blog.sigmaphoto.com/2025/a-small-but-mighty-lens-for-landscapes-and-travel-sigma-16-28mm-f2-8-dg-dn-contemporary): Darren White reviews Sigma 16-28mm F2.8 for landscape and travel photography
- [The lens cuts straight to the heart of the scene I am looking to capture.](https://blog.sigmaphoto.com/2022/the-lens-cuts-straight-to-the-heart-of-the-scene-i-am-looking-to-capture): Liam Doran reviews Sigma 24mm F1.4 DG DN Art for outdoor action sports

- [Getting Closer to Nature with the SIGMA 500mm F4 Sports Lens](https://blog.sigmaphoto.com/2020/getting-closer-to-nature-with-the-sigma-500mm-f4-sports-lens): Martina Abreu captures wildlife with handheld Sigma 500mm F4 Sports lens
